--- /inputs/pyproject.toml ---
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "skillc"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "Skill Achievability Compiler: decides whether the goal of an agent skill (SKILL.md / agent markdown) is achievable, sound for refutation"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name = "skill-achievability-compiler contributors" }]
dependencies = [
    "z3-solver>=4.12",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=7.4", "hypothesis>=6.0", "ruff>=0.6"]
# the Agent Framework middleware adapter (skillc.integrations.agent_framework); mcp 2.x breaks
# agent-framework-core 1.19 (docs/HOSTED_AGENT.md, spike results), hence the pin
agent-framework = ["agent-framework-core>=1.19,<2", "mcp>=1.30,<2"]
# the runtime monitor as an MCP server (skillc monitor mcp), for hosts without hooks
mcp = ["mcp>=1.25,<2"]
# reading building graphs (skillc twin)
twin = ["rdflib>=7"]

[project.scripts]
skillc = "skillc.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
skillc = ["data/profiles/*.json", "data/runtimes/*.json", "data/toolpolicy/*.json", "data/*.json",
          "data/env/*.json", "data/env/intents/*.json", "data/scout/*.md"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
markers = ["interaction_cases: replay of real interaction cases through the monitor"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py310"
extend-exclude = ["runs", "docs", "paper"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "B", "UP", "SIM", "C4", "RET", "PIE", "PERF"]
ignore = [
    "PERF203",   # try/except in a loop is the clearest form for per-item fallbacks
    "PERF401",   # an explicit loop is kept where it reads better than a comprehension
    "SIM108",    # ternaries are used where they help, not mandated
    "SIM905",    # a word list is clearer as one "a b c".split() than as a long literal
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# prompt texts are experiment data: their wording is fixed, not reflowed
"src/skillc/frontend/prompts.py" = ["E501"]
# tests and research scripts favour local readability over the package rules
"tests/*" = ["E402", "E501", "E731", "E741", "B023", "B904", "B905", "SIM", "RET", "PERF", "UP", "C4", "PIE"]
"scripts/*" = ["E402", "E501", "E731", "E741", "B007", "B023", "B904", "B905", "F841", "SIM", "RET", "PERF", "UP", "C4", "PIE"]
"corpus/*" = ["E402", "E501"]

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, tomllib

manifest_path = Path('/inputs/pyproject.toml')
template_path = Path('/inputs/devcontainer.json')
out_path = Path('/work/devcontainer.json')

before = {p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (manifest_path, template_path)}
project_name = tomllib.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['project']['name']
project_slug = project_name.lower().replace(' ', '-').replace('_', '-')
template = json.loads(template_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

def substitute(value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.replace('{{PROJECT_NAME}}', project_name).replace('{{PROJECT_SLUG}}', project_slug)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [substitute(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: substitute(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value

result = substitute(template)
vscode = result['customizations']['vscode']
vscode['extensions'].extend([
    'ms-python.python',
    'ms-python.vscode-pylance',
    'charliermarsh.ruff',
])
vscode['settings']['python.defaultInterpreterPath'] = '.venv/bin/python'
vscode['settings']['[python]'] = {
    'editor.defaultFormatter': 'charliermarsh.ruff',
    'editor.codeActionsOnSave': {'source.organizeImports': 'explicit'},
}
result['postCreateCommand'] = 'rm -rf .venv && uv sync && uv run /opt/post_install.py'

out_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

# Validate persisted JSON and exact requested changes.
actual = json.loads(out_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert actual == result
assert actual['name'] == project_name
assert actual['customizations']['vscode']['extensions'] == template['customizations']['vscode']['extensions'] + [
    'ms-python.python', 'ms-python.vscode-pylance', 'charliermarsh.ruff'
]
assert actual['customizations']['vscode']['settings']['python.defaultInterpreterPath'] == '.venv/bin/python'
assert actual['customizations']['vscode']['settings']['[python]'] == {
    'editor.defaultFormatter': 'charliermarsh.ruff',
    'editor.codeActionsOnSave': {'source.organizeImports': 'explicit'},
}
assert actual['postCreateCommand'] == 'rm -rf .venv && uv sync && uv run /opt/post_install.py'
assert '{{PROJECT_NAME}}' not in out_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert '{{PROJECT_SLUG}}' not in out_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
after = {p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in before}
assert before == after
assert [p.name for p in Path('/work').iterdir()] == ['devcontainer.json']
print(f'Wrote and validated {out_path} ({out_path.stat().st_size} bytes); project={project_name!r}, slug={project_slug!r}')
